messages:
bryan: Quick week1 check-in — what I did / blockers / today:
- Did: laptop image + dotfiles, Okta SSO, cloned monorepo, ran yarn install.
- Blockers: can't access infra S3 bucket (AccessDenied), docker pull from internal registry failing, SSH to bastion times out. CI job errors with missing Vault token.
- Today: open infra ticket, try to get registry creds, start the tiny inference task in onboarding doc.

devon: welcome! quick Q — can you paste the exact docker / s3 errors (copy/paste)? also put @dev-experienced on this if needed.

bryan: pasted errors below:
```bash
$ aws s3 ls s3://redwood-dev-models --profile redwood-dev
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the ListObjectsV2 operation: Access Denied
```
```bash
$ docker pull registry.redwood.internal/redwood/runtime:dev
Error response from daemon: Get https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/: net/http: request canceled while waiting for connection
```

bryan: and the CI failure snippet: "error: VAULT_TOKEN environment variable not set" from the setup step.

elaine: @bryan I just added you to infra-dev group (Okta sync done). Try the s3 command again in 2 mins. Also make sure you restarted your shell after Okta group change.

it-ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-5321 — "new-hire access: registry + s3 + vault token" assigned to infra-team. ETA: 4h.

bryan: Tried again — s3 now lists but docker still fails (timeout).

devon: try `curl -v https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/` from the laptop — if that times out, it’s probably a VPN/bastion routing rule. Also confirm you're on the corp VPN and that `ssh -A bastion` works.

bryan: curl shows TLS handshake failed. I was on the new home wifi; I switched to VPN and curl gives 200 now. Docker still reports TLS verify error when pulling: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority"

elaine: ah — corporate CA not in your system certs. run: `sudo cp /etc/corp/certs/redwood-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates` (Linux). If mac, let me know and I'll paste the brew steps.

bryan: ran the Linux steps, docker pull is progressing now. CI still failing because the onboarding job expects `VAULT_TOKEN` in secrets manager.

it-ops-bot: Update on INC-5321 — infra team added a temporary vault token for onboarding VM (token expires in 24h). See https://infra.internal/incidents/INC-5321 for details.

bryan: pulled images and spun up the local dev services. Running the tiny inference test now. Thanks!

jen: hi @bryan — welcome again! heads-up: security training session tomorrow 10am, and people-ops 1:1 scheduled for Friday.

bryan: all good — no more blockers for today, will continue with the onboarding task and ping if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
